title: Green Fee-Free Account: Complete Guide and Table of Contents
summary: This guide for a “Green Fee-Free Account” covers fees and limits for receiving domestic wires ($12.50 per incoming domestic wire) and returned deposits ($15.00 per returned item) plus the EveryonePay daily send limit ($2,000 per day). It explains when fees apply, what causes returned checks, and how sends count toward the daily cap.
faqs: What is the fee for an incoming domestic wire, and when is it assessed?
How much is charged if a deposited check is returned unpaid, and what triggers it?
What is the EveryonePay daily send limit ($2,000) and what counts toward it?
Can both the $12.50 wire fee and the $15.00 returned deposit fee apply on the same day?
If I hit the EveryonePay cap, when can I send again?
What steps should I take to reduce the risk of a returned deposit?
keywords: Returned deposit fee $15.00 per returned item
Incoming domestic wire fee $12.50 per incoming wire
EveryonePay daily send limit $2,000 per day
Wire fee assessed when wire posts
Account name exactly as it appears
Trusted, secure channels for account/routing details
